question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Vain
solution: The correct answer is: **Modest** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Vain **means having an excessively high opinion of oneself. (स्वयं के बारे में अत्यधिक ऊँची राय रखना) • **For example-** *He was so vain, he would change his clothes three times a day.* • **Modest **means having a humble or moderate opinion of oneself. (स्वयं के बारे में विनम्र या उदारवादी राय रखना) • **For example-** *She was modest about her accomplishments even though she had a lot to be proud of after the dance competition season.* • From here, it is clear that the most appropriate **antonym **of 'Vain' is 'Modest.' Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Extrovert**: Outgoing and sociable. (निवर्तमान और मिलनसार) • **Selfish**: Concerned only with one's own interests. (केवल अपने हितों से चिंतित) • **Stubborn**: Refusing to change one's opinion or course of action. (किसी की राय या कार्रवाई के तरीके को बदलने से इनकार करना) 4e:T930, The correct answer is: **went to his house **
